steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete all events scheduled for this Thursday.

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z %u'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|fossify|calendar'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dow=$(date +%u); delta=$(( (4 - dow + 7) % 7 )); th=$(date -u -d \"+${delta} day\" +%Y-%m-%d); start=$(date -u -d \"$th 00:00:00\" +%s); end=$(date -u -d \"$th 23:59:59\" +%s); b=$((start*1000)); e=$(((end+1)*1000)); echo THURSDAY=$th BEGIN_MS=$b END_MS=$e; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$b/$e --projection event_id:begin:end:title:allDay"
